meta.name: October Faction
meta.description:
Monster hunters Fred and Deloris Allen tangle with evil ... and family drama with their teenage twins. From the comics by Steve Niles and Damien Worm.

Complete series. On your server: S1 10/10

videos.title: Presidio
videos.overview: Nothing’s as scary as the specters of the past -- or ugly antiques. The Allens find out as much when a patriarch’s passing brings them home.

videos.title: No Country for Old Vamps
videos.overview: A thirst for revenge bonds Fred and Deloris. But what fuels a mystery woman's bloody travels? At school, Viv and Geoff begin to test their limits.

videos.title: The Horror Out of Time
videos.overview: As night falls, Deloris -- and Fred -- get into trouble. Later, the "parents of the year" track their prey. Viv uncovers more about her powers.

videos.title: Soirees of Future Past
videos.overview: Geoff’s seeing ghosts, but that doesn’t stop him from throwing a big blowout when Deloris and Fred leave town -- and opening the door to danger.

videos.title: Truth and Consequences
videos.overview: The dust settles after the rager, leaving Geoff and Viv seething over their parents' lies. The search is on for the intruder, but who’s hunting whom?

videos.title: Open Your Eyes
videos.overview: A deadly crew enters the scene, ushering in a series of shocking developments. Viv shields her strange new friend while Phillip tries out the truth.

videos.title: Nadir
videos.overview: Fred faces Seth’s killer and strikes an unprecedented deal to battle the blood magic. In the meantime, Viv and Geoff get to know their kidnapper.

videos.title: Alice
videos.overview: Alice recalls a time she opened up to a friend and the gut-wrenching moment her world was violently torn apart. Geoff and Viv discover their origins.

videos.title: Bonds of Blood
videos.overview: All things hidden are revealed. Alice takes her revenge, Fred and Deloris get a taste of monstrous pain, and Viv and Geoff feel their strength.

videos.title: The October Faction
videos.overview: Gate Night goes sideways, unlikely alliances form, and the twins must join forces when Presidio cracks down -- and the entire town faces obliteration.
